// Package uuid generates and inspects UUIDs.
//
// UUIDs are based on RFC 4122 and DCE 1.1: Authentication and Security
// Services.
//
// A UUID is a 16 byte (128 bit) array.  UUIDs may be used as keys to
// maps or compared directly.
